jobs.occupation: CSA Cost Manager - Data Center Construction
jobs.description:
Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 10,000 people in 48 countries. Collaborating with our clients across real estate, infrastructure and natural resources sectors, we specialise in major programmes, programme management, cost and commercial management, net zero and digital solutions.

We are seeking applications from experienced CSA Cost Managers with experience in working on major construction projects for the Data centre sector.

Job Objectives

• 
Pre and post-contract duties including preparation of cost estimates, procurement and tendering, contract administration, variation, final account, etc.

• 
Completing feasibility studies and writing procurement reports

• 
Estimating and cost planning to include producing and presenting the final cost plan

• 
Tendering and procurement activity, including managing the pre-qualification stage, producing the tender list, preliminaries, tender analysis, tender report and compiling the contractual documents

• 
Taking responsibility for timely and accurate cost checks and valuations

• 
Producing monthly post contract cost reports and presenting them to the client

• 
Interfacing with the client and other consultants, at all project stages

• 
Participate effectively with post contract cost variances and the change control processes

• 
Perform cost risk analysis and provide input into value engineering; negotiate and approve final accounts

• 
Maintain central feedback and learning on cost estimating from prospects and projects and contribute to updating of best practices in estimating

• 
Technical knowledge of Data centre or other related facility asset types

• 
Experience in CSA construction, industrial, pharma, manufacturing and/or Mission Critical sectors.

• 
Good knowledge of all methods of construction and procurement.

• 
Experienced with, or managing team that uses multiple estimating tools and applications.

• 
Strong experience with spreadsheets and databases.

• 
Collaborative approach, able to develop strong relationships with clients and stakeholders, internally and externally.

• 
Good organization skills with the ability to multi-task.

• 
Demonstrated strong listening and communication skills.

• 
Proven cost and/or commercial management experience, ideally within a consultancy environment

What We Offer:

• Exciting work in an international environment.

• Independent work with challenging tasks.

• International development perspectives and training opportunities.

• Additional benefits such as fitness initiatives, discounted event and cultural highlights, as well as shopping opportunities.

• Employer-funded pension plan.

• Modern workplace in centrally located offices with good transport connections.

We are looking forward to your application!

Contact person:

Anne Stoffregen

Senior Talent Acquisition Manager

www.turnerandtownsend.com

Lead one of the most ambitious global transformation programmes in the VELUX Group and help shape the future of customer engagement across our business. With your strong programme leadership experience and ability to bridge business and technology, you will play a key role in delivering a global CRM platform that enables better customer experiences, stronger commercial performance, and lasting business value.

Meet your future team

You will join our global Sales Enablement & Strategic Pricing organisation and work closely with colleagues across Sales, Marketing, Customer Service, Finance, and IT & Digital Excellence. In this highly visible role, you will collaborate with senior leaders, project teams, business stakeholders, and external partners across the VELUX Group.

You will report to the VP Sales Enablement & Strategic Pricing, with a dotted reporting line to the VP IT & Digital Excellence, Sales & Marketing.

As Global CRM Program Lead, you will be accountable for driving our global CRM transformation programme from strategy through implementation and business adoption. You will act as the connecting link between commercial ambitions, technology delivery, and organisational change, ensuring alignment across markets while creating value for the business.

What We Offer

This is an opportunity to take ownership of a strategically important global programme and influence how the VELUX Group engages with customers for years to come. You will be given significant responsibility, engage with senior stakeholders across the organisation, and lead a complex transformation that reaches across functions and geographies.

More specifically, your tasks will be to:

• Define and drive the overall CRM programme strategy, roadmap, governance, and delivery approach.

• Ensure alignment between business objectives, technology solutions, and value realisation across all markets.

• Lead executive stakeholder management, steering committees, and programme decision-making.

• Manage programme scope, budget, risks, dependencies, and benefits realisation.

• Oversee implementation partners and ensure high-quality delivery of CRM solutions, integrations, and data migration activities.

• Drive global rollout planning, market readiness, adoption, and change management activities.

• Build strong collaboration across Sales, Marketing, Customer Service, Finance, and IT functions.

What You Will Bring

You are an experienced programme leader who thrives in complex, international environments and can successfully navigate the space between strategy and execution. You combine strong commercial understanding with technology insight and know how to bring people together around a common goal.

Moreover, we expect that you:

• Hold a Master's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

• Have extensive experience leading large-scale CRM or enterprise transformation programmes in global organisations.

• Have a proven track record of delivering complex cross-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholders, markets, and external partners.

• Understand commercial processes within Sales, Marketing, and Customer Service and how technology can enable business value.

• Bring strong financial and business acumen, including experience managing programme budgets and business cases.

• Have experience working with CRM platforms such as Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics 365, or similar solutions.

• Excel at stakeholder management and are confident engaging with senior leaders and executives.

• Bring programme or project management certifications such as PgMP, PMP, PRINCE2, MSP, or SAFe, which will be considered an advantage.

• Are a collaborative and resilient leader who creates alignment, drives decisions, and delivers results.

Ready to apply?

Learn more about the VELUX Group online at www.velux.com where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect of our recruitment process.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have the right match.

All inquiries will be treated confidentially.

About VELUX

In the VELUX Group, we offer you a world of opportunities and the chance to create a bright future. From the forefront of the roof window category, we enable those who live, work and play under the roof transform their spaces and live a healthier everyday life with more daylight and fresh air.

The VELUX Group is an international, family-owned business with strong financial roots and each year we can create real impact by reinvesting in society, our employees and planet through our foundations. With 20 production companies in 12 countries and sales companies in 37 countries, our products are widely available. We employ around 12,000 people, and our company is headquartered in Denmark. Alongside the rest of our values, “courage” and “mutual respect” define our actions every day and how we wish to contribute to the world.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At the VELUX Group, we believe in fostering a diverse workplace for everyone to thrive, develop, and perform at their best, and where you feel welcome, respected, and valued. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all, whether you are applying for a role or already a part of VELUX. That means we recruit, hire, train, and promote people based on their skills and potential without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, age, neurodiversity, disability, protected veteran status, national origin, sexual orientation or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

We value diversity and strive to ensure that our employment decisions are fair and inclusive, focusing only on what truly matters: your qualifications and how you can contribute to our shared mission and success.

Senior Software Developer | Hospitality Tech Startup

Help shape the future of hospitality software

I'm partnering with an ambitious hospitality-tech startup that's rethinking how hotels and venues operate.

The hospitality industry still relies on fragmented systems that weren't built to work together. Teams spend too much time navigating software, handling manual processes, and managing operational complexity instead of focusing on creating memorable guest experiences.

My client is changing that.

They're building an AI-powered platform that brings bookings, operations, communication, housekeeping, invoicing, and automation into one seamless experience.

As part of their product team, you'll help design software that thousands of hospitality professionals rely on every day.

This is an opportunity to join a fast-growing company where design is viewed as a strategic advantage and where your ideas can influence both product direction and customer outcomes.

You'll work closely with founders, engineers, commercial teams, and customers to create experiences that solve real-world problems and deliver measurable value.

The Product

The platform acts as an operating system for hotels and venues.

From reservations and guest management to housekeeping, invoicing, tasks, reporting, and AI-powered workflows, everything lives in one connected system.

The goal isn't simply to improve existing tools.

It's to redefine how hospitality businesses operate.

Culture & Team

This is a team that values ownership, speed, and continuous improvement.

They move quickly, challenge assumptions, and believe the best products are built by people who care deeply about both the problem and the user experience.

You'll join a highly collaborative environment where design, product, and engineering work closely together to deliver value fast.

The company works primarily from the office because they believe the strongest collaboration, fastest learning, and best product decisions happen when talented people solve problems side by side.

Backed by experienced SaaS founders and operators, you'll have the opportunity to learn from people who have built and scaled successful technology companies before.

What You'll Get

✅ High ownership and influence from day one

✅ Close collaboration with founders and key decision-makers

✅ Direct access to customers and user feedback

✅ Fast development cycles with weekly releases

✅ The opportunity to solve meaningful, real-world challenges

✅ An attractive warrant package

✅ A culture built around learning, experimentation, and growth

✅ Regular social events, Friday bars, and hackathons

✅ A team of ambitious people who genuinely enjoy building great products

What You'll Be Doing

·       Building and maintaining core platform functionality using Laravel and Vue.js

·       Designing and implementing scalable backend services and APIs

·       Developing intuitive frontend experiences and user-facing features

·       Writing automated tests and contributing to code quality initiatives

·       Collaborating with product and design teams to deliver customer value quickly

·       Identifying performance, reliability, and scalability improvements

·       Monitoring production systems and contributing to operational excellence

·       Leveraging modern AI tools and development workflows to improve productivity and product quality

Who You Are

You're an experienced Software Developer who enjoys building products that solve real-world problems.

You thrive in environments where you can take ownership, move quickly, and see the direct impact of your work. You care about writing maintainable code, building scalable solutions, and collaborating closely with both technical and non-technical colleagues.

You likely:

·       Enjoy solving complex technical challenges with simple, elegant solutions

·       Take ownership of your work and proactively drive improvements

·       Care about code quality, testing, and long-term maintainability

·       Are comfortable making decisions and navigating ambiguity

·       Enjoy collaborating with product, design, and commercial teams

·       Constantly look for better ways of working, including leveraging AI tools where relevant

·       Value feedback, learning, and continuous improvement

Requirements

·       5+ years of experience working with Laravel in production environments

·       Experience with Vue.js or another modern frontend framework

·       Strong experience working with MySQL

·       Experience with Tailwind CSS

·       Experience with automated testing frameworks such as PHPUnit and Playwright

·       Solid understanding of Git and modern development workflows

·       Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Sentry

·       Strong communication skills in English

·       A collaborative mindset and the ability to contribute positively to a high-performing team

Nice to Have

·       Experience building SaaS products

·       Experience working in startup or scale-up environments

·       Experience with AI-assisted development tools

·       Experience building high-availability or business-critical applications

·       Interest in hospitality, travel, or operational software

This Role Might Not Be Right For You If...

• 
You prefer highly structured environments with multiple approval layers

• 
You enjoy focusing exclusively on either product or brand design

• 
You're uncomfortable speaking directly with customers

• 
You prefer long planning cycles over rapid execution

• 
You thrive best in large organizations with narrowly defined responsibilities

Interested in hearing more?

If you'd like to be part of a team building the next generation of hospitality software, we'd love to hear from you.

Day to day, you can look forward to:

• Three days' additional paid leave for volunteering.

Valuing our differences helps us see possibilities where others can't. We therefore welcome and encourage applications from all abilities, experiences, and backgrounds. **Manager, GTM Systems & Innovation

**Hybrid (minimum of 2-3 days a week from the office)

**

Shape the Future of Privacy

**Usercentrics is a global leader in data privacy and privacy-led marketing solutions. We believe there is no need for a trade-off between growth and privacy compliance. Our vision is to unlock the potential of data privacy to empower a thriving digital ecosystem. We work with companies to create a healthy balance between data-driven business and privacy-led marketing for every size of enterprise. Our customers build trust with their users through improved transparency and control to drastically improve marketing and monetization, while achieving full privacy compliance.

**About the Role

**Revenue Operations is the horizontal backbone behind Usercentrics' three go-to-market motions — Self Serve, Sales Led, and Partner Led. As we scale, our Salesforce ecosystem and wider GTM tech stack need a single owner who can turn ambitious business requirements into governed, scalable systems. As Manager, GTM Systems & Innovation, you'll lead a team spanning Salesforce administration and GTM engineering, and you'll be the one deciding how AI-native automation gets built into our GTM workflows. You'll partner closely with other Revenue Operations teams, the broader GTM organization, and stakeholders across Finance and Product to translate business requirements into efficient, reliable systems.

**Responsibilities

**> Own CRM architecture and governance end-to-end, ensuring Salesforce supports Self Serve, Sales Led, and Partner Led without compromising on data integrity.

> Set the roadmap and standards for the wider GTM tech stack, tying every major investment to a clear business outcome - pipeline quality, forecasting reliability, or support efficiency - not just tool delivery.

> Lead and grow a small team spanning Salesforce administration, Salesforce architecture, and GTM engineering, keeping the team focused on high-impact initiatives tied to clear business outcomes, and acting as the final technical decision-maker on system changes.

> Drive AI-native workflows and automation across GTM - from propensity and churn scoring models to workflow automation - that reduce manual work, increase seller and CS productivity, and improve the customer experience.

> Own attribution and data hygiene practices, partnering closely with BI on the underlying data infrastructure and pipeline.

> Drive adoption and value realization of the systems you build, partnering with GTM Enablement to make sure new capabilities actually change day-to-day behavior, not just go live.

> Continuously evaluate GTM tooling and market trends, bringing investment recommendations to the VP of Revenue Operations based on expected business impact and ROI.

**Requirements

**

**Experience

**> 5+ years of experience in RevOps, Salesforce administration and GTM systems, with real ownership of architecture-level decisions.

> Experience managing a technical team in a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.

**Technical Skills

**> Deep, hands-on Salesforce expertise (architecture, automation, integrations).

> Practical experience with tools like n8n, Clay, and Outreach, and with AI-assisted workflows in a revenue context.

**Operating Skills

**> Strong data instincts: comfortable owning attribution, data hygiene, and governance across a growing tech stack.

> Confident operating independently and making system decisions without needing to escalate every call.

> Comfortable being the technical backstop for a Solution Architect, Administrator, and Engineer, without needing to do the hands-on build yourself day to day.

Include:

> Hybrid working policy and the possibility to take a workcation (90 days per year from a European country

jobs.occupation: Head of Translational Medicine and Early Development
jobs.description:
Application deadline: November 29th, 2026

Location: Ballerup 2750, Denmark, Denmark

Contract type: Permanent

Job ID: 4988

**Turn scientific promise into clinical progress. Build the proof-of-concept engine that helps LEO Pharma make smarter development decisions and bring meaningful innovation closer to patients.

****Shape What Comes Next

**How would you connect emerging biology, quantitative insights, and clinical expertise to shape the next generation of development programs? At LEO Pharma, you will lead Translational Medicine & Early Development, bringing together people, partners, and evidence to answer critical questions early. This is an opportunity to build capabilities, influence portfolio decisions, and connect scientific ambition with a clear path to clinical proof of concept.

**Your role

**You will build and lead an integrated proof-of-concept engine, translating biological hypotheses into clinically testable, quantitatively informed, decision-ready programs. Working across internal teams and external partners, you will establish mechanism-based rationales, meaningful patient strategies, and robust development plans. Your focus will be on generating the evidence needed to select doses, assess benefit–risk, and guide progression toward registrational studies.

Your primary responsibilities will be to:

• Lead translational and early-development strategy across programs, developing people leaders and subject-matter experts.

• Partner with Science, Search & Innovation and clinical teams to design early-phase studies demonstrating target engagement, proof of mechanism, and patient relevance.

• Integrate biomarkers, patient stratification, quantitative pharmacology, and modelling and simulation to optimize doses, regimens, endpoints, and study designs.

• Support clinical due diligence and integration of externally sourced assets, building partnerships that strengthen translational capabilities.

• Shape regulatory and cross-functional evidence strategies, translating complex findings into clear recommendations for project teams and governance forums.

You will also establish progression criteria and performance indicators that strengthen decision quality, evidence maturity, execution, and resource efficiency. Throughout early development, you will ensure efficacy hypotheses are considered alongside safety, tolerability, and therapeutic index.

**Your Qualifications

**You bring scientific depth and leadership experience, with the ability to connect translational evidence to clinical and portfolio decisions.

We are looking for:

• An advanced degree in Medicine, Pharmacology, Translational Science, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related discipline; MD and PhD qualifications are preferred.

• Significant leadership experience in translational medicine, clinical pharmacology, and/or early clinical development within biotech or pharma.

• Demonstrated expertise in early-phase studies in patients and healthy participants, linking mechanisms of action and biomarkers to dose selection and development strategy.

• A track record of building high-performing global teams, developing people, and integrating external assets and partnerships.

• Experience contributing to regulatory submissions and evidence generation supporting registration and market access.

Experience with externally sourced innovation is strongly preferred; dermatology and/or rare-disease experience is beneficial. You combine strategic thinking with curiosity, sound judgment, and a collaborative approach, influencing effectively across a matrix organization.

**Your new team

**You will lead Translational Medicine & Early Development, with two line managers as direct reports, the group is in total 20 employees. You will report to the Vice President, Head of Global Clinical Development.

Your network will span clinical development, skin science, regulatory, safety, market access, and commercial colleagues. Together with external collaborators, you will connect expertise across disciplines to strengthen early development.

**Contact and application

**For additional information, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner, Sabina Ravn Lebech at saleb@leo-pharma.com

You do not need to upload a cover letter, but feel free to add a few sentences in your resume or CV on why this position has your interest.

_**Beyond the skin

**__Join LEO Pharma, a global leader in medical dermatology, as we go beyond the skin to make a lasting impact. Our innovative approach sets us apart. We are dedicated to leaving a legacy that positively impacts patients, colleagues, and our planet.

__At LEO Pharma, we believe in the power of individuals to drive change. Our flat organizational structure empowers you to make a visible impact and offers versatile roles for professional growth. We value diversity and welcome applications from all qualified candidates, recognizing that our different perspectives, backgrounds, and attitudes enable us to make the best decisions. Join our passionate team at LEO Pharma and be yourself as we work together to make a difference.

__For certain positions, LEO Pharma might complete a background check conducted by a third party.

Apply by uploading your CV and grades no later than November 23rd.

We review applications and invite selected candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, or disability.

Location: Central Copenhagen, near Vesterport Station

Work Assignments

As an Experienced Data Engineer, you will operate at the intersection of deep technical expertise and business advisory. You will be responsible for:

• 
Technical Design & Development: Designing and developing modern data solutions, ensuring our team implements the highest standards of data engineering.

• 
Advisory & Collaboration: Acting as a trusted partner for our clients’ decision makers, ensuring good collaboration with their engineers, analysts, & business users.

• 
Mentorship & Growth: Elevating our team of less experienced engineers through mentoring and fostering a culture of continuous technical improvement.

You will collaborate with our experienced data engineers, while quickly taking a mentoring role for our many less experienced consultants.

What You Bring to the Team

Ideally, you have:

• 
Solid experience working as a Data Engineer.

• 
Proficiency in Python, SQL, or APIs.

• 
Previous experience with some of these technologies: Snowflake, Databricks, Fabric, dbt, Azure, AWS, or GCP.

• 
An analytical approach to problem-solving, with a strong interest in how to drive business improvement using data.

• 
Clear communication skills and the curiosity to engage with clients on projects.

• 
A relevant degree.

• 
A base near Copenhagen and fluency in English.

If you’re excited about this role but you don’t tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply.

Why Devoteam Data Driven?

You will join a fantastic team of talented, curious data experts in a collaborative and dynamic workplace. Beyond working with nice colleagues on impactful projects, we offer comprehensive benefits to support your growth:

• 
Continuous Growth & Community: We invest in your talent and dedicate time for learning to ensure you have up-to-date certifications in our technologies.

• 
Work-Life Balance: We prioritize your personal time. In addition to your six weeks of paid vacation, we offer the flexibility of taking unlimited unpaid time off.

• 
Social Events: We offer a variety of social events throughout the year. Recently we have done Lasertag, Pottery, Disc Golf, Book Club, Curling, Board Game Night, Foosball Tournament, Ice Hockey, among many other things.

Our Impact

Below are a few examples of our work:

• 
Migrated Novo’s global supply chain analytics solution from Alteryx-based workflows to a governed, cloud-native architecture using dbt, Snowflake, and Azure DevOps to support enterprise-scale analytics and collaboration.

• 
Developed a comprehensive end-to-end data warehouse solution, featuring automated pipelines that structured dimensional data from diverse operational systems for unified analytics for a client.

• 
Assessed the current data landscape in Novonesis and implemented a new self-service framework to enable business users to utilise the power of the modern data stack.

Application Process

Apply by uploading your CV no later than October 18th.

We review applications and invite selected candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, or disability.

About Devoteam

Devoteam is a leading digital consultancy represented in 25 countries in Europe with +11,000 employees. In Denmark, our team is around 350 people and spread across four business teams – Data Driven (our team), a ServiceNow team, a Digital Management Consultancy team & a Google Cloud team – each focused on different aspects of digital transformation.

About Us

Tandoori Twist is an offering from Tinyhus Cafe, a child-friendly cafe in Copenhagen, Denmark, serving authentic Indian delicacies. 

We serve not only classic favourites like butter chicken and biriyani, but also lesser known Indian regional food, with myriad of spices and flavours as our specilities.

Our cafe Tinyhus serves continental food, also traditional local cuisines for events and catering. 

We strive to provide authentic food and exceptional service to our guests and we look for team members who are self-motivated, proactive and passionate to walk the extra mile to provide exceptional culinery experience for our guests. 

Our people, just like our food, are the ambassadors of our cafe and restaurant. If you like challenges and you are looking for a place where you can contribute positively, overcoming the odds of a new but growing restaurant, then please do get in touch; we will look forward to hear from you.

Job Description - Restaurant Manager –Indian Dining Experience

We are seeking a dynamic, hands-on Restaurant Manager to take full ownership of our service. If you have a passion for authentic Indian cuisine and the drive to build a high-performance culture, we will look forward to welcome you to lead our team.

This is not a back-office role. We are looking for a visible leader who thrives on the floor, inspires the team, and ensures every guest leaves with a memorable experience.

Responsibilities:

Service ownership: Take complete charge of the dining room, ensuring service personnel are attentive, aligned, and delivering our high-quality service standards.

Team Leadership: Build a high-performance culture through hands-on training, onboarding, and continuous development of the service team.

Guest Experience: Actively engage with diners, capture valuable feedback, and guarantee ultimate guest satisfaction.

Operations & Standards: Hands-on maintenance of high-quality hygiene and take full control of FOH supplies, inventory, and stock.

Digital Presence: Manage our social media channels to showcase our vibrant dishes, culture, and events.

Who We Are Looking For:

· Experience: 3–4 years of proven leadership experience in the hospitality industry is essential.

· Cuisine Expertise: Deep knowledge of Indian cuisine is essential; prior management experience in an Indian restaurant is highly preferred.

· Language: High-level fluency in English.

· Personality & Presence: Outgoing, hardworking, and naturally hospitable. You bring a "service with a smile" mentality and project a welcoming, highly professional presence on the floor.

· Bonus Skills: Hands-on experience with beverage pairing, craft cocktails, and premium coffee making will give you a significant advantage.

What We Offer:

· A highly competitive salary.

· Autonomy to shape the service culture and FOH operations.

· A vibrant, fast-paced work environment with a passionate team.

· Opportunities for long-term career growth.

Ready to lead our service?

Please send your CV (including a professional headshot) and a cover letter describing your experience and motivation to info@tandooritwist.dk.

jobs.occupation: Logistik koordinator samt Adhoc transport opgaver
jobs.description:
Jobbeskrivelse

Vi søger en struktureret og ansvarsbevidst logistikkoordinator til vores virksomhed.

Stillingen omfatter koordinering og planlægning af daglige logistik- og transportopgaver samt praktisk deltagelse i virksomhedens transport- og lageraktiviteter.

Arbejdsopgaver:

* Koordinering og planlægning af daglige transportopgaver.

* Organisering og opfølgning på leverancer og distribution.

* Håndtering af ad hoc-transportopgaver efter virksomhedens behov.

* Kommunikation med chauffører, kunder og samarbejdspartnere.

* Koordinering af afhentning og levering af varer.

Kvalifikationer:

Ansættelsesvilkår:

Do you enjoy keeping a team moving without getting in the way? Are you the kind of producer who loves making work life easier for your team through process? And are you also quite silly?

We're expanding one of our games and looking for a Senior Producer to help drive new content and features for our players. You'll work very closely with the executive producer and game director, supporting them in setting a clear production plan within time and budget constraints, while making sure the team has everything they need to do their best work.

You'll also be part of a cross-studio producer team where you can exchange ideas, challenge each other, and share knowledge and complementary skills.

**Here's What That Looks Like Day To Day

**

• Implement and refine production processes and tools, shaping how we work and grow as a studio

• Drive the project forward by removing roadblocks and keeping delivery dates realistic

• Facilitate the team’s day-to-day rhythm (stand-ups, planning, reviews, post-mortems)

• Plan updates, roadmaps, and marketing beats together with the leads, and communicate plans clearly to stakeholders

• Manage the project long-term: priorities, scope, timelines, risks, and follow-up

• Take on team and people responsibility, including 1:1s, development reviews, and salary conversations

Last, but not least: There's plenty of room to shape this role to fit you.

**Must-haves

**

• Experience going through at least one full game production cycle

• Experience as a producer on at least one shipped game

• Experience with live service and online games

• Experience working with external stakeholders

• A deep understanding of the game development process

• A strong belief in nurturing team wellbeing because a sustainable pace and motivation directly shape the quality of what ships

• Experience with people management (development talks, hiring, 1:1s) and team production (version control, stand-ups, sprints, reviews)

• You’re ready to tell us where we’re going wrong and help us improve

**What Always Matters To Us At Triband

**We've always believed that games are made by teams, not solo superstars, and good ideas can come from anyone. We love people who bring curiosity, generosity, flexibility, and strong opinions, especially when those opinions come with reasoning, openness, and a willingness to validate ideas properly.

We also care a lot about experimentation. Sometimes the weird idea is not the right fit. Sometimes the weird idea is the entire game! The trick is being able to explore it together, learn from it, and not get too precious when the experience tells us we're wrong.

**Practicalities

**

• We don't offer relocation support or visa sponsorship for this role.

• We work a 37-hour work week, with core hours 10-15, and the freedom to start and finish anywhere between 7 and 18.

• We work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen.

• No crunch. People over deadlines.

• Our working language is English.

**We offer

**

• Silly but ambitious projects, and the chance to work on and impact great games that reach millions of players.

• A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged.

• Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games.

• A professional development budget to invest in your growth.

• Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights, team events, you name it.

• Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).

• Six weeks of vacation (five standard plus one extra on us).

• Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement.

• Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked.

• Pension plan and private health insurance.

• Endless amounts of coffee.

**WHAT THE TRIBAND?

**Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, which is played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make everyone laugh. To do so, we focus on exploring comedy through gameplay. We like to break player expectations, use wonderful music, slick art, and create a quirky atmosphere. We experiment a lot, and it doesn't always work out, but we always learn something.

We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games, and we believe diversity makes for better teams. For these reasons, we look for people who bring new perspectives and will challenge us and our way of doing things.

For more info about Triband, check out: triband.net/about

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, which is played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.

To do so, we focus on exploring comedy through gameplay. We like to break player expectations, use wonderful music, slick art, and create a quirky atmosphere. We experiment a lot, and it doesn’t always work out, but we always learn something.

We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games - and we believe diversity makes for better teams. For these reasons, we look for people who make the team better, bring new perspectives, and will challenge us and our way of doing things!

jobs.occupation: Graduate Cloud Infrastructure Engineer – Medical Software
jobs.description:
MagVenture is an established medical device company specialized in the TMS technology (Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation), which is rapidly being adopted for treatment and investigation of a number of difficult mental and physical disorders such as depression and pain.

MagVenture is on a rapid international growth journey with many exciting new products to come and that is why we need a new colleague to strengthen our software and cloud operations.

Would you like to join this growth adventure? - then apply!

The job – working with Azure infrastructure and databases

You will become part of our growing software activities and play an important role in the deployment, operation, and maintenance of our cloud-based medical software solution.

Working closely with experienced software developers, engineers, Product Managers, and external technology partners, you will help manage our cloud infrastructure and databases, currently hosted on Microsoft Azure, and support the reliable operation of applications used by clinics worldwide.

The role offers an opportunity for a recently graduated engineer or IT professional with some practical experience in cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud to develop hands-on skills in cloud infrastructure, database management, automation, cybersecurity, and medical software.

You will gradually take on more responsibility as you become familiar with our systems, working alongside experienced colleagues and external specialists.

The role will be based out of our Headquarters in Farum, Denmark. Danish visa is required.

Tasks

You will support the deployment and ongoing operation of our cloud infrastructure and databases, primarily within Microsoft Azure. Your responsibilities will include:

• Setting up and configuring new customer environments, including domains, certificates, and regional deployments.

• Assisting with software releases, upgrades, and deployment activities.

• Monitoring cloud availability, database performance, capacity, and system health using cloud monitoring tools.

• Supporting incident investigation, troubleshooting, backup monitoring, and recovery activities.

• Helping maintain cloud and database security, access management, credentials, and environment configurations.

• Supporting Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automation, and integration with development pipelines.

• Monitoring cloud resource utilization and supporting cost optimization.

• Maintaining technical documentation and supporting cybersecurity, regulatory compliance, and audit requirements.

• Collaborating with internal development teams and external partners to continuously improve our cloud infrastructure.

Qualifications

We acknowledge a broad set of backgrounds, but typically look for:

• Recently completed or soon-to-be-completed degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, IT Engineering, Cloud Computing, or a related technical discipline.

• Practical experience with cloud platforms and databases (Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, or similar) through student jobs, internships, university projects, or previous employment.

• Basic understanding of cloud infrastructure, networking, databases, and application deployment.

• Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, or CloudFormation is an advantage.

• Experience with scripting, automation, CI/CD pipelines, or monitoring tools is considered a plus.

• Interest in cybersecurity, cloud operations, and reliable software systems.

• Structured and analytical approach with strong attention to detail.

• Good organizational and project management skills, with the ability to work across international teams and stakeholders.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; Danish is an advantage.

Experience with regulated environments, healthcare software, or data protection requirements is considered a plus.

Who are you?

• You are an ambitious recent graduate or early-career professional looking to develop your career in cloud engineering within a high-tech medical device company.

• You already have some hands-on experience with cloud technologies and enjoy understanding how systems work, solving technical problems, and improving reliability and performance.

• You are comfortable taking responsibility for your tasks, eager to learn from experienced colleagues, and enjoy working with people from different technical backgrounds.

• As a person you have a positive attitude with a helpful and curious mindset, and you value honest and direct communication.

What can you expect from us?

MagVenture is an innovation focused company with a low-key, family owned culture. We practice work life balance and flexibility. We offer an exciting journey with plenty of challenges and room for development – both personally and professionally – working with great colleagues supporting each other. We are eager to welcome you to our modern headquarters in Farum with an excellent lunch prepared by a local chef every day.

How to apply?

We are hoping to find the right candidate, starting as soon as possible, preferably before the year-end. We will call for interviews on an ongoing basis, so you are encouraged to submit your application as soon as possible.

We look forward to receiving your motivated application and CV.

Do you want to know more about us?

MagVenture currently employs 240 employees, and we are a privately owned Danish company. MagVenture is the sister company of Tonica Elektronik that was founded in 1991, and has, since then, grown organically from a location in a small basement to becoming a global market-leading manufacturer of magnetic stimulators.

Our products are used for a wide range of psychiatric and cognitive research purposes as well as neuro-rehabilitation, neurology & diagnostic. Our mission is to pioneer safe, effective, and reliable magnetic stimulation therapies, offer innovative and versatile research solutions and work to expand access to magnetic stimulation worldwide.

Learn more at www.magventure.com

jobs.occupation: Technical expert in inks & coatings, plastics: Technical Product Specialist or Head of Product Development
jobs.description:
About Octarine

Octarine Bio is a Copenhagen-based biotech company making safe, sustainable, bio-based pigments. Our PurePalette™ platform uses precision fermentation and renewable raw materials to produce colourants that can replace petrochemical and mined pigments.

We are a team of around 15 people, working across pigment manufacturing, formulation and application development, and commercial development. As our pigment manufacturing processes reach full commercial scale, and our first pigment products are now in the hands of customers and partners, we are looking for someone with deep domain expertise in one or more of our core application areas (dyeing, printing, coatings and plastics) to make PurePalette™ work in real industrial applications and turn successful customer trials into lasting commercial products.

The role

You will be the technical owner of the PurePalette™ product range and the link between our lab and our customers. You will translate what the market needs into clear performance targets, work with our scientists to meet them, and make sure our pigment products perform once they reach a customer's processes.

We are looking for an applications expert in inks and coatings, plastics, or both, or in a closely related pigment application field. The title and scope will match your experience:

• Technical Product Specialist if you are earlier in your career and want a role with a lot of room to grow as the company scales.

• Head of Product Development if you have the experience to lead the product and applications function, shape the product roadmap and build a team.

In both cases you will report directly to our Chief Scientific Officer and work closely with our commercial team.

What you will do

Own the product, technically

• Be the technical expert for all PurePalette™ products and the first point of contact for technical questions from customers, partners and colleagues.

• Define the performance and quality parameters customers expect in each application, such as colour strength, dispersibility, heat stability, light and weather fastness, migration, rheology, and wash and rub fastness.

• Plan and coordinate the internal and external testing needed to prove each parameter, and turn the results into clear data packages for customers.

• Own, write and maintain our technical and product documentation, including Safety Data Sheets (SDS), Technical Data Sheets (TDS), Certificates of Analysis (CoA), product specifications and application guides.

Make our pigments work for customers

• Work with customers, distributors and partners to implement PurePalette™ products in their processes, from first lab trial to production run.

• Own the technical side of our partnerships with masterbatchers, ink manufacturers, dyehouses and research institutes. Set up project plans, manage technology transfer between parties, and troubleshoot problems until the product works in the target application.

• Handle technical customer feedback and complaints, find the root cause and feed lessons back into product and process development.

Decide what to develop next

• Identify where bio-based pigments offer real value to end users, and where they can genuinely meet customers' performance expectations.

• Work with Octarine scientists to map which applications our current pigments suit, and which applications we should target with future products.

• Work with our formulation and application scientists to refine formulations (dispersions, masterbatches, inks, dye and print pastes) to meet customer requirements.

• Work with our R&D and process teams to develop and implement strategies that improve pigment performance, for example through stabilisation, surface treatment or particle engineering.

• Benchmark our products against incumbent pigments and competing bio-based alternatives.

Connect technical and commercial

• Act as the bridge between Octarine's technical and commercial teams, translating customer needs into technical requirements and technical results into customer value.

• Join customer meetings, site visits and trade fairs as the technical voice of the company.

• Contribute technical content to sales materials, grant applications and investor discussions, and help capture new inventions for our IP portfolio.

What you bring

Pigment applications are many markets, not one. Printing inks alone span flexo, gravure, offset, screen and digital printing, and each places different demands on a pigment. The end markets differ just as much, from packaging and textiles to toys, consumer goods and coatings, each with its own performance, safety and regulatory requirements.

We need someone who knows this landscape in depth. You should understand the technical and performance requirements of each sub-application and market, judge where our pigments have a realistic and valuable fit, and work with our scientists to develop products that meet those requirements.

Specifically, we are looking for:

• An MSc or PhD in chemistry, polymer or materials science, chemical engineering, colour science or a related field, or equivalent industrial experience.

• Hands-on industrial experience applying pigments or colourants in textiles, inks and coatings, plastics and masterbatch, or a closely related field. For the Head of Product Development level, we expect around 5 or more years, including leading projects or people.

• A practical understanding of pigment dispersion and of how pigment properties such as particle size, surface chemistry and thermal stability affect performance in the final product.

• Experience with colour measurement (spectrophotometry, CIELAB, ΔE) and with standard ISO, EN or ASTM test methods for pigment and application performance.

• Experience writing or maintaining SDS, TDS and CoA documents, and working knowledge of REACH and CLP.

• Experience working directly with customers or external partners on trials, scale-up or technology transfer.

• The ability to explain technical results clearly to scientists, customers and commercial colleagues.

• A structured, self-driven way of working, and comfort with the pace and ambiguity of an early-stage company.

• Fluent written and spoken English.

• The confidence to take full ownership of the role from day one. You will set your own priorities, make decisions within your remit and drive projects to completion without close supervision, keeping the CSO informed rather than waiting for direction.

Nice to have

• Experience in both inks and coatings and plastics.

• Experience with textile dyeing or printing.

• Experience with organic pigments, natural colourants or other bio-based materials.

• Knowledge of food contact and product safety requirements, such as EU 10/2011, the Swiss Ordinance, EuPIA guidelines, EN 71-3 or ZDHC.

• Experience with quality systems such as ISO 9001, or with setting product specifications for a new product.

• An existing network in the European ink, coatings, masterbatch or textile industries.

What we offer

• A central role in bringing a new class of sustainable pigments to market, with real influence over which products we build and how.

• Direct work with the founding team and a short path from idea to decision.

• A small, highly skilled team of scientists across synthetic biology, fermentation, downstream processing, formulation and application.

• For earlier-career candidates, a role that can grow with the company. For senior candidates, the chance to build and lead the product function.

• Real autonomy and ownership of your work, and the chance to make a lasting impact at a fast-growing company developing new materials for industries that urgently need to change.

Practical details

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark. On-site is strongly preferred; hybrid working is possible for the right candidate.

Start date: As soon as possible

Reports to: Chief Scientific Officer

Employment: Full-time, permanent

Travel: Some travel to customers and partners within Europe

Right to work: Applicants must already have the right to live and work in Denmark. We are unfortunately not able to sponsor work visas at this time.

How to apply

Apply with your CV. Please highlight the pigment applications you have worked on and a technical problem you solved in a customer's process.

We review applications on a rolling basis and will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply early.

We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and are happy to answer questions about the role before you apply.

Does it excite you to build the marketing engine for an upcoming obesity and metabolic health launch, and do you have experience with turning brand strategy into integrated, compliant go-to-market plans? If this sounds like you, and you are ready to take on a broad area of responsibilities, then you could be our new colleague.

**Your new position

**As Senior Director, Global Marketing Strategy, you will build and lead the marketing capabilities that bring Zealand Pharma’s medicines to healthcare professionals and patients. The role translates brand strategy into customer engagement, channel, and campaign plans, and creates the foundation for a scalable marketing organization. You will be the commercial voice in building the core brands towards a successful launch.

**We Offer Exciting Responsibilities

**

• Define brand strategy, including positioning, segmentation and brand building to a strong value proposition

• Develop the go-to-market and marketing strategy, translating brand strategy into integrated, multichannel plans

• Build the marketing function, including team structure, processes, and agency and vendor partnerships

• Own marketing planning, budgeting, and performance measurement

• Lead launch-readiness activities for marketing, e.g. campaigns, tools, and customer engagement models

• undefined

• Ensure promotional activities comply with regulatory and internal review requirements, in partnership with Medical Affairs and Legal

• Collaborate with Commercial, Market Access, and the U.S. organization to align execution across markets

**Your profile

**You are a strategic thinker who connects market, HCP and consumer needs into a compelling story. You influence without relying on authority, bring clarity in ambiguity, and enjoy building something new in a growing organization.

• Extensive experience in brand strategy within pharma or biotech, including senior leadership responsibility

• Track record from global or regional launches, ideally in obesity, diabetes, or other metabolic or specialty areas

• Experience with omnichannel and digital engagement strategies for healthcare professionals and patients

• Solid understanding of promotional compliance and review processes

• Experience managing budgets, agencies, and marketing analytics

• Experience working in matrixed, international settings, ideally with alliance or partner models

• Master degree, e.g. life sciences, business. MBA is a plus

• Fluency in English

**Your new team

**You will be a member of the global commercial organization reporting into the Senior Vice President. You will be part of building the area and will work closely with our external partners and with key stakeholders, e.g. Medical Affairs, R&D, Market Access, Alliance Management.

**Let’s bond and be bold

**We have a unique culture, characterized by excellent teamwork and strong engagement across the organization. And we want you to help us strengthen this culture.

Making bonds is at the core of everything we do. From discovering and developing the best new peptide drugs for patients, to engaging with our partners or connecting with each other. We bond through curiosity and playfulness as a team, allowing ourselves to challenge common thinking and drive future innovation. Join us and let’s bond and be bold.

Interested in bonding with us? Then please apply no later than 15 November 2026, or as soon as possible. The applications will be reviewed as they come in. While a cover letter is not required, please include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.

For further information, please contact Senior Vice President Mette Zacho, MZacho@zealandpharma.com .

We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and welcome applications from all job applicants.

**About Zealand Pharma A/S

**Zealand Pharma A/S (Nasdaq: ZEAL) is a biotechnology company focused on advancing medicines for obesity and metabolic health. Combining more than 25 years of peptide R&D expertise with a proprietary data platform that leverages advanced data-driven and AI/ML approaches, Zealand Pharma aims to lead a new era in obesity and metabolic health. To date, more than ten Zealand Pharma-invented drug candidates have entered clinical development, of which two products have reached the market and three candidates are in late-stage development. The Company has collaborations with global pharmaceutical and biotechnology partners for research, development, and commercialization. Founded in 1998, Zealand Pharma is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, with a U.S. presence in Boston, Massachusetts. Learn more at www.zealandpharma.com.

Sophion Bioscience is looking for an ambitious, customer-focused Vice President of Research & Development to lead and further develop our R&D organization.

This is a central leadership role with responsibility for Sophion’s technology strategy, product development execution, engineering capabilities, and R&D organization. You will ensure that priorities, resources, budgets, and development activities are managed with clarity and discipline, enabling us to deliver high-quality products that create measurable value for customers.

You will report to the CEO and as a member of the Senior Leadership Team, you will contribute to Sophion’s overall direction and continued growth.

About the role

As VP R&D, you will lead and develop Sophion’s multidisciplinary R&D organization, setting a clear direction and creating the structure, leadership, and ways of working needed to deliver on our ambitions.

You will translate product and portfolio priorities into clear R&D priorities, roadmaps, and resource commitments, ensuring alignment and accountability across the organization. Working closely with Innovation, Market & Product Management, you will ensure R&D brings strong judgment and execution discipline to the development of differentiated and commercially successful products.

A key part of your mandate will be to strengthen the R&D organization and its leadership. You will develop leaders, build effective teams, establish clear governance and decision-making, and create a culture of collaboration, ownership, and delivery.

You will attract, develop, and retain talented people and ensure that R&D continues to grow in capability, maturity, and performance.

About Us

Since 2000 Sophion Bioscience has pioneered Automated Patch Clamping for ion channel research. Today, we specialize in automated solutions for pre-clinical life sciences.

We work closely with academic institutions, contract research organizations, and leading biotech and pharmaceutical companies to create effective assays for screening and characterization. Our solutions empower the study of drug targets and candidates at the bench, reducing development time in discovery and reducing risk in clinical trials.

Through the continued development of our Automated Patch Clamp portfolio (QPatch & Qube) and our new Organ on a Chip platform (Ethica), we offer uncompromised data quality in a user-friendly environment, from assay setup to advanced data analysis.

We are driven by curiosity, teamwork, and a genuine passion for helping scientists succeed. We work in an open and collaborative environment where people share knowledge freely, support each other across roles and borders, and take pride in doing things properly. Our culture is informal, trusting, and grounded in respect — for colleagues, customers, and the science we enable. Even as we grow globally, we remain a company where people feel welcome, included, and able to make a meaningful impact.

We are headquartered in Denmark and have subsidiaries in the United States, Japan, and China.

What You'll Do

• Set and execute Sophion’s R&D and technology strategy in alignment with the company’s overall direction and priorities.

• Lead and develop the R&D organization, including its structure, leadership capabilities, ways of working, and competencies.

• Clearly communicate R&D priorities, progress, risks, and trade-offs across Sophion and to the Leadership Team and Board.

• Own the R&D budget and ensure resources are allocated to the activities that create the greatest strategic and customer value.

• Drive portfolio and resource management, translating product priorities into actionable development roadmaps and execution commitments while balancing short- and long-term priorities.

• Ensure customer needs inform development decisions by driving broad R&D engagement with the market, key opinion leaders, and key accounts.

• Strengthen development governance, decision-making, accountability, milestones, KPIs, and transparent reporting.

• Drive continuous improvement in product quality, performance, reliability, and maintainability.

• Work closely with Innovation, Market & Product Management to assess opportunities and convert agreed priorities into robust and commercially viable products.

• Maintain appropriate quality and compliance standards across R&D activities.

• Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders

Who You Are

You are a strategic and hands-on R&D leader who can turn complex scientific and technical opportunities into high-quality products.

You bring clarity to complex situations and combine strong judgment with disciplined execution. You build strong teams, set clear priorities, use resources effectively, and deliver commitments.

**Deliver with focus. Scale with intent 🚀

**Are you a delivery leader who knows how to guide enterprise customers through complex set-ups without over-engineering the journey? Do you care deeply about building scalable, repeatable SaaS delivery rather than one-off custom projects?

At Performativ, we’re building the infrastructure layer for modern wealth management. As our Engagement Manager, you’ll lead the enterprise rollout of our SaaS platform helping customers onboard successfully through structured delivery, clear communication, and lightweight technical engagement.

This is not a professional services consulting role. You won’t be buried in endless customer-specific code or heavy customizations. Instead, you’ll work cross-functionally to help customers adopt our product the right way: cleanly, securely, and in line with platform best practices so they can scale on top of us, not around us.

**What You Will Do

**

• Own enterprise set-up programs end to end (kick-off through go-live and hyper-care) against an agreed plan and scope (Statement of Work).

• Enable customers to integrate Performativ via standard platform patterns (APIs, SSO, configuration) without custom buildouts, working with product and engineering to flag gaps early and advocate for scalable paths.

• Own plan, scope, and change control, keeping scope tied to contract and change visible and decided rather than quietly absorbed, and support the Technical Program Lead on requirements, design documents, and acceptance-criteria sign-off.

• Run customer communication, cadence, and governance with reporting that keeps meetings short, and manage risk, dependency, and issue tracking (including customer-side).

• Lead a clean handover to Customer Success at go-live or hyper-care exit, including train-the-trainer sessions and supporting materials.

• Represent the program in internal capacity and exception reviews, bringing requests the plan cannot absorb back as options rather than committing on the spot.

• Build repeatable playbooks, documentation, and artefacts that make the next program faster. You will be measured on this, not only on your own delivery.

**How You Will Work

**You will run multiple programs at once, in a delivery pod alongside the Technical Program Lead, Integration Engineers, Data Migration Specialists, and Product Engineers. None report to you. Rather you get things done through clarity and relationships, not authority. You will report to the COO. This is an in-office role based at our Copenhagen office.

**What We're Looking For

**

• 7+ years in program or engagement management, consulting, product management, or another delivery-facing role, with a track record of leading complex, multi-stakeholder implementations end to end.

• Comfort being firm with customers on scope and timeline while keeping the relationship stronger for it.

• Any industry background welcome. Experience with enterprise customers (banks, asset managers, regulated industries), balancing urgency against long-term maintainability highly advantageous.

• Structured and highly organized, producing written plans, governance cadences, and reporting that stakeholders can act on.

• Broad technical literacy across enterprise SaaS delivery: API-based integrations, SSO and security configuration, and data migration and mapping, including enough SQL to read and question a mapping. You do not build the integration, but you understand it well enough to scope it, question it, and know when something does not add up.

• Ability to build working fluency in the customer's business domain fast: within 90 days, able to discuss topics such as advice and suitability workflows and customer reporting without a subject-matter expert in the room.

• ITIL Foundation, PMP or PRINCE2 Certification would be beneficial.

**Technical Fluency

**

• You’re not, necessarily, a developer, but you’re comfortable with APIs, data structures, auth flows (OAuth/SAML), and deployment models.

• You can dive into logs, payloads, and basic SQL or Python when needed to unblock yourself or a customer - but you prioritize scalable fixes over tactical workarounds.

• You advocate for platform-aligned solutions, not special cases.

**What This Role Is Not

**This role sits in operations, not engineering or commercial, and is project-based: once delivery is complete, you roll on to the next engagement. As a SaaS provider, we do not build bespoke software; delivery works within the bounds of the product.

**We Can Offer

**

• Trust and responsibility to shape how Performativ delivers for its largest customers.

• A competitive salary and benefits package.

• A fast-growing, VC-backed fintech scaleup, working alongside professionals from leading institutions (Goldman Sachs, McKinsey, BCG, Amazon and others).

• Career acceleration through professional development and leadership opportunities.

**Join Our Team as a Quality Control Manager

**We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Quality Control Manager to lead and develop our incoming quality control activities. This is a key role within our organization, ensuring that incoming materials and components meet quality requirements while supporting continuous improvement across our operations.

The successful candidate will play an important role in maintaining product quality, driving process improvements, and supporting production through strong quality leadership.

**Key Responsibilities

****Incoming Quality Control

**

• Take overall responsibility for Incoming Quality Control (IQC) activities.

• Ensure all incoming materials, components, and products comply with established quality requirements and specifications.

• Investigate and manage supplier-related quality issues and non-conformances.

• Work closely with Procurement, Supply Chain, Production, and Engineering teams to resolve quality concerns.

**Process Development and Improvement

**

• Lead the implementation of new procedures and standards for incoming inspection processes.

• Continuously improve inspection methods, quality controls, and efficiency.

• Develop and maintain inspection plans, acceptance criteria, and quality documentation.

• Support supplier qualification and supplier quality improvement initiatives.

**Quality Documentation

**

• Own and maintain controlled documents related to Quality Control activities.

• Ensure procedures, work instructions, forms, and records are current, accurate, and compliant with applicable standards and internal requirements.

• Support internal and external audits as required.

**Team Leadership

**

• Directly manage and develop one QC Technician.

• Conduct performance reviews, provide coaching, and support employee development.

• Foster a culture of quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**Operational Support

**

• Participate in daily production meetings and provide quality-related input.

• Collaborate with production teams to address quality concerns and minimize disruptions.

• Support root cause investigations and corrective and preventive action (CAPA) activities.

• Monitor quality performance and drive actions to improve product and process quality.

**Qualifications

**

• Bachelor's degree in Quality Management, Engineering, Manufacturing, or a related technical field.

• Minimum 3-5 years of experience in Quality Control, Quality Assurance, or Manufacturing Quality.

• Previous leadership experience is preferred.

• Experience with incoming inspection processes and supplier quality management.

• Familiarity with ISO 9001 and other relevant quality management systems.

• Strong knowledge of incoming inspection methodologies, AQL (Acceptable Quality Level) sampling plans, CAPA, Root Cause Analysis, and Statistical Process Control (SPC).

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and quality management software systems.

• Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

**Personal Competencies

**We are looking for a candidate who is:

• Structured and detail-oriented.

• Proactive and solution-focused.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

• A strong communicator with excellent collaboration skills.

• Results driven with a continuous improvement mindset.

• Capable of balancing strategic initiatives with day-to-day operational responsibilities.

**What We Offer

**

• An exciting opportunity to shape and improve our quality processes.

• A collaborative and professional working environment.

• Opportunities for personal and professional development.

• Competitive salary and benefits package.

• The chance to make a significant impact on product quality and operational excellence.
